```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Packages needed:
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
here::i_am("Descriptive_Statistics/source_S1_desc_stat.Rmd")
library(here)
```

```{r}
data <- read.table(here("processed", "COWG_gamm_2004_2018.csv"), sep=';', dec='.', header=T) %>% 
  mutate_at(18:23, as.factor)
data$Dates <- as.Date(data$Dates, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
data$Corrected_Dates <- as.Date(data$Corrected_Dates, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
```

# Rainfall time series 

```{r}
rain <- ts(data$Rainfall, start = c(2004,10), end = c(2022,6), frequency = 12)
plot.ts(rain, xlab='Time', ylab="Precipitations (in mm)")
# mm = L/m^2
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
fit_rain <- decompose(rain)
plot(fit_rain)
```

```{r}
monthplot(rain, ylab = "Precipitations (in mm)")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
acf(rain, type="correlation", main='')
acf(rain, type="partial", main='')
```

# General study

```{r}
fit <- data.frame(
  Dates = data$Corrected_Dates,
  Sb = as.numeric(fit_antimoine$trend),
  As = as.numeric(fit_arsenic$trend),
  Cd = as.numeric(fit_cadmium$trend),
  Conductivité = as.numeric(fit_cond$trend),
  Cu = as.numeric(fit_copper$trend),
  FeII = as.numeric(fit_ion$trend),
  Pb = as.numeric(fit_lead$trend),
  O2 = as.numeric(fit_O2$trend),
  pH = as.numeric(fit_pH$trend), 
  Pluie = as.numeric(fit_rain$trend),
  Pluie_30daysdelay = as.numeric(fit_rain2$trend),
  SO4_2 = as.numeric(fit_sulfate$trend),
  Temperature = as.numeric(fit_temp$trend),
  Zn = as.numeric(fit_zinc$trend)
)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

fit_scaled <- fit %>%
  mutate_at(names(fit[2:15]),
            function(x) rescale(x))
```

```{r}
library(plotly)
p <- ggplot(fit_scaled, aes(x = Dates)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Sb, color = "Sb")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = As, color = "As")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Cd, color = "Cd")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Conductivité, color = "Conductivité")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Cu, color = "Cu")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = FeII, color = "FeII")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = O2, color = "O2")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pH, color = "pH")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Pluie, color = "Pluie des 30 derniers jours")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Pluie_30daysdelay, color = "Pluie des 30 jours encore avant")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Pb, color = "Pb")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = SO4_2, color = "SO4 2-")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Temperature, color = "Température")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Zn, color = "Zn")) + 
  scale_x_date(breaks = data$Corrected_Dates, date_breaks = "4 months", labels = date_format("%Y-%m")) +
  labs(y = "Valeurs standardisées", color = "Variables") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

g <- ggplotly(p) %>% 
  layout(hovermode = "x unified")
g
```

```{r}
library(htmlwidgets)
saveWidget(g, here("Réunions","COWG_gamm_interactive_plot.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
```
